source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 10 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wielding the Invisible Sling. spell. Hurls an unrestrained nearby object that a person could throw; it always hits for damage based on the object, up to +5, but is resisted by Magic Resistance. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 10 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Forgiving Earth. spell. Loosens earth across a 15-by-15-pace area to a depth of one foot, making packed dirt like plowed soil. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 10 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Unseen Porter. spell. Carries inanimate objects with roughly the strength of a very strong person, moving more slowly with heavier loads and never lifting above 6 feet. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 10 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Unyielding Earth. spell. Compacts ground across a 15-by-15-pace area to a depth of one foot, making mud like soft earth and soft earth like packed dirt. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 15 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Earth's Carbuncle. spell. Turns a one-pace circle into jagged stone whose fragments burst upward, throwing and striking those standing there for +10 damage. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 15 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hands of the Grasping Earth. spell. Earthen hands seize a target’s ankles for Diameter duration; escape needs a Strength stress roll of 15 or more, and a hand can be destroyed by a Light Wound after overcoming its +25 Soak. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 20 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Crest of the Earth Wave. spell. Sends a ground wave outward at about 50 paces per round, reaching 5 feet high and 30 paces wide and dealing +10 damage to those who fail to evade it. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 30 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Creeping Chasm. spell. Opens a deepening chasm toward a chosen target at about 4 paces per round, reaching 20 feet wide at 30 paces; natural forces may close it in about a week. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 30 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Earth Shock. spell. Shakes the ground in a 100-pace radius, potentially knocking everyone in the area down. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 30 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Earth Split Asunder. spell. Opens a 5-by-60-foot crack 10 feet deep for one round, then closes it violently on the next, crushing those inside for +25 damage; maintaining concentration controls the three-round sequence. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Terram Spells, Level 75 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hermes' Portal. spell. Creates a near-instant route between two sites after simultaneous rituals at both, each performed with an Arcane Connection to the other; a set command activates passage. [verb move; also needs dimension-travel] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Creo Vim Spells, General (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Restore the Faded Threads. spell. Temporarily restores extant spell traces to their fresh condition, affecting traces down to negative magnitude equal to the spell magnitude minus three. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Creo Vim Spells, General (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shell of False Determinations. spell. Places a magical shell on an item so investigations report false powers unless the investigator’s roll exceeds half the shell’s level. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Creo Vim Spells, General (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shell of Opaque Mysteries. spell. Makes investigations of an item fail unless the investigator exceeds the ritual’s level; after overcoming the shell, that investigator is no longer blocked by it. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Creo Vim Spells, Level 15 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Phantom Gift. spell. Makes a person without the Gift seem magically tainted, causing beasts and people to treat them as a magus, though existing acquaintances remain nonhostile. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Creo Vim Spells, Level 30 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Enigma's Gift. spell. Gives a target four permanent Warping Points, usually in addition to one for the powerful supernatural effect, and may trigger a magus’s Twilight check. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Intellego Vim Spells, General (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Invisible Eye Revealed. spell. Lets the caster feel magical spying currently directed at them when the spying effect is no more than twice this spell’s level. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Intellego Vim Spells, Level 2 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sense of Magical Power. spell. Identifies whether the caster is in a Magic aura, without further information. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Intellego Vim Spells, Level 5 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Scales of the Magical Weight. spell. Compares raw vis with a known quantity to determine its pawn amount, but cannot measure vis invested in an enchanted item. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Intellego Vim Spells, Level 5 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sense the Nature of Vis. spell. Reveals the Art associated with raw vis through a corresponding visible aura. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Intellego Vim Spells, Level 20 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Piercing the Faerie Veil. spell. Shows through Faerie regio boundaries and indicates a route to the next level. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Intellego Vim Spells, Level 30 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sense of the Lingering Magic. spell. Detects active spells and many magical residues of at least zero magnitude, reporting their power but not other details. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Intellego Vim Spells, Level 40 (ars-magica-core#032); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sight of the Active Magics. spell. Shows active spells as auras whose colors indicate Forms and whose shapes indicate Techniques, though other magic can disguise them. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Muto Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Mirror of Opposition. spell. While another spell is being cast, reverses its effects, usually leaving its target unchanged, subject to the limits of Hermetic magic. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Muto Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shroud Magic. spell. Suppresses or changes the sigil of a spell being cast, and can affect a spell no more than twice its own level. [verb alter; also needs conceal-or-sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Muto Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Sorcerer's Fork. spell. Splits a spell no higher in level than itself into identical, weaker castings against separate targets, dividing its power and Penetration. [verb law: divide] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Muto Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wizard's Boost. spell. Raises a spell’s power by 5 levels, without exceeding its own level, and cannot affect the same spell twice. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Muto Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wizard's Communion. spell. Lets a group of magi combine their casting to cast one specified spell, with one additional participant allowed for every 5 levels of that spell. [verb law: combine] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Muto Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wizard's Reach. spell. Increases a target spell’s Range by one category, if that spell is at least one magnitude lower in level. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Muto Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wizard's Vigil. spell. Uses the group-casting method of Wizard’s Communion for Ritual spells, but counts as two magnitudes lower for that purpose. [verb law: combine] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Perdo Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Demon's Eternal Oblivion. spell. If it penetrates an Infernal creature’s Magic Resistance, reduces its Might Score by the spell’s level. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Perdo Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Disenchant. spell. Permanently destroys every power in a Hermetic magic item if the spell level plus a stress die meets or exceeds its highest enchantment level, consuming the vis used to make it. [verb end] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Perdo Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Masking the Odor of Magic. spell. Hides a spell or magical power from Intellego magic unless that detection spell exceeds twice this spell’s level minus 5. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Perdo Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Unravelling the Fabric of (Form). spell. Cancels one spell of a specified Form if its level is no higher than this spell’s level plus 10 and a stress die. [verb end] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Perdo Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wind of Mundane Silence. spell. Cancels spells in a room when its level plus a stress die is at least twice their level, subject to penetration against Magic Resistance; it does not affect Momentary spells. [verb end; also needs area-field] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Circular Ward against Demons. spell. Prevents Infernal creatures with Might no greater than its level from entering a circle or harming those within, and a stronger recasting replaces a weaker one. [verb block; also needs containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Maintaining the Demanding Spell. spell. Automatically maintains a concentration spell the caster has already cast for this spell’s duration, but does not let the caster change its effects without concentrating. [verb law: sustain] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Opening the Intangible Tunnel. spell. Creates a concentration-maintained magical channel to a target through which the caster can cast spells up to the tunnel’s level, subject to penetration against Magic Resistance. [verb move; also needs power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Suppressing the Wizard's Handiwork. spell. Temporarily cancels one active spell cast by the caster while concentration is maintained; its effects fade and return over about one round each. [verb law: suppress] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Vim Spells — General (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Watching Ward. spell. Ritually holds one or more spells on a present target until a specified condition triggers them, with the Ward’s level at least equal to their combined levels. [verb release; also needs power-interaction] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Rego Vim Spells — Level 15 (ars-magica-core#033); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Gather the Essence of the Beast. spell. Concentrates raw vis in a corpse into one part that can be removed. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Spells Index, p. 332 (ars-magica-core#047); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Bind Wound. spell. The index lists this Creo Corpus spell at level 10, without explaining its effect here. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Definitive Edition: Spells Index, p. 339 (ars-magica-core#047); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Bridge of Wood. spell. The index lists this Creo Herbam spell at level 20, without explaining its effect here. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Horn of the Champions — Sounding the Alarm (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sounding the Alarm. spell. Once per day, it makes the horn audible to a target Group at any distance when the user has an Arcane Connection to each member. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: The Horn of the Champions — Summoning the Champions (ars-magica-houses#001); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Summoning the Champions. spell. Once per day, it instantly transports each connected member of a target Group to the horn, though recipients can resist. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Indirect Spells from ArM5 (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Strings of the Unwilling Marionette. spell. Controls a target like an animated body, with indirect attacks potentially made through a nonmagical weapon. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Indirect Spells from ArM5 (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Walking Corpse. spell. Animates a corpse, whose nonmagical weapon can bypass Magic Resistance while its magical bodily attack cannot. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Indirect Spells from ArM5 (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Trap of the Entwining Vines. spell. Surrounds a target with vines that restrict movement without completely immobilizing her. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Animal Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Summoning the Creeping Death. spell. Creates an asp that obeys mental commands for two minutes; its bite is resisted using the caster’s Penetration Total. [verb law: summon; also needs creature-control] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Rego Animal Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Fury of the Charging Bull. spell. Makes an animal up to Size +3 attempt a Personality roll against Ease Factor 9 or fly into a potentially indiscriminate rage. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Aquam Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Dagger of Ice. spell. Creates and hurls a foot-long icicle that hits if it penetrates Magic Resistance and inflicts +5 damage. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Aquam Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Alchemist's Revenge. spell. Splashes a target with acid for +15 damage if it penetrates Magic Resistance, and may damage equipment. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Rego Aquam Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Shackles of the Frozen Ice. spell. Freezes a roughly five-pace-wide pool area for a day, trapping those in it; escape requires Strength rolls from Ease Factor 6 to 21 according to how much of the body is encased. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Auram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Catapult of the Mighty Winds. spell. Hurls an object on a high arc, requiring an aiming roll at –3 with an extra botch die; the airborne object’s natural motion bypasses Magic Resistance and usually inflicts +10 damage on impact. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Muto Auram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Curse of the Evil Humors. spell. Creates a foul-air cloud about 20 paces across and 10 high; exposed characters roll Stamina against Ease Factor 6 or contract a disease causing a Medium Wound. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Rego Corpus Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Wizard's Leap. spell. Instantly transports the caster up to 50 paces to a visible destination or one linked by an Arcane Connection, automatically bringing a Talisman. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Muto Herbam Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Aegis of Unbreakable Wood. spell. Makes a wooden shield as strong as iron and adds +1 Defense without changing its weight, though it remains vulnerable to fire. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Perdo Herbam Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Tree Falling in the Forest. spell. Fells a tree in a chosen direction, allowing an aimed attack for up to +18 damage that can pin victims and bypass Magic Resistance. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Ignem Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Test of the Flames. spell. Fills a ring with waist-high fire that deals +5 damage each round until the ring is broken or its duration ends. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Ignem Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Last Flight of the Phoenix. spell. Imm olates the caster and deals +40 damage within four paces, +20 from four to six paces, and +5 from six to ten paces. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Perdo Ignem Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Quench the Raging Conflagration. spell. Extinguishes a fire as large as a house fire. [verb end] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Rego Ignem Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Obedient Fire. spell. Controls where and how quickly fire spreads, but cannot stop it burning what it touches; aimed fire can reach a target and its nonmagical heat bypasses Magic Resistance. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Mentem Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Heart of the Lion. spell. Raises a person’s Brave Personality Trait by +3 for a day, potentially making the person reckless and less afraid of the caster. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Terram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sword from the Unseen Scabbard. spell. Creates a steel longsword for two minutes, which requires an Intelligence + Finesse roll at Ease Factor 6 and must penetrate to harm a magic-resistant opponent. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Creo Terram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Silvery Scales of the Knight. spell. Conjures full chain mail for a day, with normal armor load and donning time; its magical gauntlets prevent punching or grappling magic-resistant creatures. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Muto Terram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hardness of Adamantine. spell. Makes a metal object nearly unbreakable, adding +2 Protection to metal armor or +1 damage to an edged or pointed weapon for a day. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Perdo Terram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Undoing the Stonemason's Handiwork. spell. Breaks a one-pace section of masonry into loose stones, but has no effect on solid stone. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Perdo Terram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hauberk of Sublime Lightness. spell. Makes metal armor nearly weightless for a day, reducing Load to 1 for a partial suit or 2 for a full suit without removing its bulk. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Rego Terram Spells (ars-magica-houses#003); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ominous Levitation of the Weighty Stone. spell. Moves a stone through the air at bird speed while the caster concentrates; when control ends it falls naturally, bypassing Magic Resistance, for damage from +5 to +21 depending on size. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Opening spell description (ars-magica-houses#004); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Stone Projectile. spell. Launches a sling-sized stone that can hit without being stopped by Magic Resistance, dealing +5 damage at a 20-pace range increment. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Species Magic Example (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Scattering Like Light. spell. This level 30 spell turns metal into iconic species, disintegrating the object, or can reform the species as a smooth metal coating in a suitably arranged reflective box. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Transparency Examples — Ambush on the Deserted Road (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Ambush on the Deserted Road. spell. This spell suppresses the species emitted in one direction by things inside its circle, hiding them from observers in that direction while leaving them visible to others. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Transparency Examples — Hiding in the Crowd (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Hiding in the Crowd. spell. This spell hides the caster from one known viewer by suppressing the caster’s species in a narrow cone; the viewer must remain still or move predictably for the effect to work. [verb conceal] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Synaesthesia Examples — Glowing Footprints of the Thief (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Glowing Footprints of the Thief. spell. This spell turns the scent traces left by a person into visible light so that nearby observers can follow them. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Synaesthesia Examples — Sight of the Warm Surface (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Sight of the Warm Surface. spell. This spell changes the touch-perceived species emitted by warm surfaces into visible species. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Synaesthesia Examples — A Visible Demand for Repair (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: A Visible Demand for Repair. spell. This spell makes the groans and squeaks of damaged equipment visible, granting +3 to Craft or Profession rolls to find flaws. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: Tricks of Interpretation — The Brushstrokes Revealed (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: The Brushstrokes Revealed. spell. This spell makes the species from an object more vivid, revealing tiny construction details that are otherwise difficult to see. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: States of Consciousness (ars-magica-houses#006); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: Call to Slumber. spell. This is cited as a template for spells that alter a target’s mental state, including sleep. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ars Magica 5e Houses of Hermes and Covenants: An Enemy Awash in the Pure Sigil of the Magus (ars-magica-houses#007); licence Ars Magica Open License
note: An Enemy Awash in the Pure Sigil of the Magus. spell. Overloads one target’s sight with concentrated visible species until the spell ends, with recovery taking two minutes or only a round if the target promptly shuts their eyes. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)
